answer: All non-Federal Government CubeSats with any type of active or passive imager must obtain a remote sensing license from NOAA's Commercial Remote Sensing Regulatory Affairs (CRSRA) (15 CFR 960.2(c) (AMDDATE: 2026-08-18)).
scope: Planning aid, not legal authority. Every regulatory statement here carries a section-level citation pinned to the corpus AMDDATE, or the product abstains and says why. Verify against the cited text before you file.
